Scrambled eggs: the pile is about 8x6 cm and thin, so roughly 60 g. At about 150 kcal per 100 g, that is about 90 kcal.

Yellow pieces: each is about 4x2x2 cm, around 15-20 g, so five pieces come to about 90 g. If they are fried yuca at about 200 kcal per 100 g, that is about 180 kcal. If they are pineapple they would be about 50 kcal, but they look fried, so I'll go with roughly 150 kcal.

Total: about 150 g of food and about 240 kcal.
